product_metadata.title: Dicunoy Ceramic Salt and Sugar Container, Condiment Jars with Lids and Spoons, Marble Seasoning Spice Pots Bowl, Pepper Sellar with Wooden Tray for Serving, Counter, Home, Kitchen

Easy to Use and Storage - Our marble condiment pots come with 3colors, which is easy to distinguish what you need in one sight, a bamboo spoon to help you use it conveniently, the wooden lid will keep your bottle and counter clean, it won't take up any valuable counter space this beautiful condiment canister!

Muti-functional - Our ceramic storage tank not only can holder salt, pepper, spice but also powdered creamer, coffee, etc. Which can be a useful container and a nice decoration in your office table, home, kitchen or tearoom, etc.

Perfect Gift - Our ceramic condiment jar can be a useful holder in daily life and without taking too much space. It's a nice gift for your friends and relatives in birthday, holidays, weddings and so on.

Modern Design - Dicunoy ceramic condiment jars are designed on a fashionable dark green surface with golden lines, special square shapes easy to catch and take food out, matter surface make it look elegant and uneasy to slip during used.
